content: marketplace.json lives at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in repo root. Required top-level: name (kebab-case, reserved names blocked e.g. claude-code-plugins/anthropic-*), owner{name required, email/url optional}, plugins[]. Each plugin entry requires name + source (string relative path like ./plugins/x resolved against marketplace root, or object {source:github|url|git-subdir|npm|archive|command, repo/url/path, ref?, sha?}). Optional entry fields: version, description, author, category, tags, strict (default true = plugin.json is authority; false = marketplace entry is sole definition, conflicts fail), defaultEnabled. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces (fetched directly).
